articles.title_en: The Impacts of Managerial Autonomy on Firm Outcomes
articles.title_cn: 管理层自主权对企业绩效的影响
articles.abstract_en: The allocation of decision‐making power is a critical choice that organizations make to mitigate agency problems and information frictions. This paper investigates the role of delegation for organizations where the agency problem is both pervasive and has potentially high welfare consequences: state‐owned enterprises (SOEs). I use a natural experiment in India to uncover the causal effects of granting SOE managers more autonomy over strategic decisions. Managers meaningfully exercise this autonomy, which results in greater value added, but also a reduced emphasis on outcomes valued by the government, such as a reduction in worker amenities (employee housing), and an increase in markups. Returns to autonomy are higher for firms with higher baseline incentive conflict.
articles.abstract_cn: 决策权的分配是组织为缓解代理问题和信息摩擦所做的关键选择。本文研究了在代理问题普遍存在且可能具有高福利后果的组织——国有企业中，授权的作用。我利用印度的一项自然实验来揭示赋予国有企业管理者更多战略决策自主权的因果效应。管理者切实行使了这种自主权，这导致了增加值的提高，但也减少了对政府重视结果的关注，如工人福利（员工住房）的减少和加价的增加。对于基线激励冲突较高的企业，自主权的回报更高。

articles.title_en: Aggregate Implications of Barriers to Female Entrepreneurship
articles.title_cn: 女性创业障碍的总体影响
articles.abstract_en: We develop a framework for quantifying barriers to labor force participation (LFP) and entrepreneurship faced by women in India. We find substantial barriers to LFP, and higher costs of expanding businesses through hiring workers for women entrepreneurs. However, there is one area where female entrepreneurs have an advantage: the hiring of female workers. We show that this is not driven by the sectoral composition of female employment. Consistent with this pattern, policies promoting female entrepreneurship can significantly increase female LFP even without explicitly targeting female LFP. Counterfactual simulations indicate that removing all excess barriers faced by women entrepreneurs would substantially increase the fraction of female‐owned firms, female LFP, earnings, and generate substantial gains for the economy. These gains are due to higher LFP, higher real wages and profits, and reallocation: low productivity male‐owned firms previously sheltered from female competition are replaced by higher productivity female‐owned firms previously excluded from the economy.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们开发了一个框架，用于量化印度女性面临的劳动力参与（LFP）和创业障碍。我们发现劳动力参与存在显著障碍，且女性创业者通过雇佣工人扩大业务的成本更高。然而，有一个领域女性创业者具有优势：雇佣女性工人。我们表明，这并非由女性就业的部门构成所驱动。与此模式一致，促进女性创业的政策可以显著提高女性劳动力参与，即使没有明确针对女性劳动力参与。反事实模拟表明，消除女性创业者面临的所有额外障碍将大幅提高女性所有企业的比例、女性劳动力参与、收入，并为经济带来可观收益。这些收益源于更高的劳动力参与、更高的实际工资和利润，以及重新配置：先前受保护免受女性竞争的低生产率男性所有企业被先前被排除在经济之外的高生产率女性所有企业所取代。

articles.title_en: Sparse Network Asymptotics for Logistic Regression Under Possible Misspecification
articles.title_cn: 可能误设下逻辑回归的稀疏网络渐近性
articles.abstract_en: Consider a bipartite network where N consumers choose to buy or not to buy M different products. This paper considers the properties of the logit fit of the N × M array of “i‐buys‐j” purchase decisions, Y=[Yij]1≤i≤N,1≤j≤M, onto a vector of known functions of consumer and product attributes under asymptotic sequences where (i) both N and M grow large, (ii) the average number of products purchased per consumer is finite in the limit, (iii) there exists dependence across elements in the same row or same column of Y (i.e., dyadic dependence), and (iv) the true conditional probability of making a purchase may, or may not, take the assumed logit form. Condition (ii) implies that the limiting network of purchases is sparse: only a vanishing fraction of all possible purchases are actually made. Under sparse network asymptotics, I show that the parameter indexing the logit approximation solves a particular Kullback–Leibler Information Criterion (KLIC) minimization problem (defined with respect to a certain Poisson population). This finding provides a simple characterization of the logit pseudo‐true parameter under general misspecification (analogous to a (mean squared error (MSE) minimizing) linear predictor approximation of a general conditional expectation function (CEF)). With respect to sampling theory, sparseness implies that the first and last terms in an extended Hoeffding‐type variance decomposition of the score of the logit pseudo composite log‐likelihood are of equal order. In contrast, under dense network asymptotics, the last term is asymptotically negligible. Asymptotic normality of the logistic regression coefficients is shown using a martingale central limit theorem (CLT) for triangular arrays. Unlike in the dense case, the normality result derived here also holds under degeneracy of the network graphon. Relatedly, when there “happens to be” no dyadic dependence in the data set in hand, it specializes to recently derived results on the behavior of logistic regression with rare events and i.i.d. data. Simulation results suggest that sparse network asymptotics better approximate the finite network distribution of the logit estimator. A short empirical illustration, and additional calibrated Monte Carlo experiments, further illustrate the main theoretical ideas.
articles.abstract_cn: 考虑一个二分网络，其中N个消费者选择购买或不购买M种不同的产品。本文考虑了在渐近序列下，N×M的“i购买j”购买决策数组Y=[Yij]_{1≤i≤N,1≤j≤M}对消费者和产品属性的已知函数向量的logit拟合的性质，其中(i)N和M都增长变大，(ii)每个消费者平均购买的产品数量在极限中是有限的，(iii)Y的同一行或同一列的元素之间存在依赖性（即二元依赖性），以及(iv)购买的真实条件概率可能取或不取假定的logit形式。条件(ii)意味着极限购买网络是稀疏的：所有可能的购买中只有消失比例被实际进行。在稀疏网络渐近性下，我证明了索引logit近似的参数解决了特定的Kullback-Leibler信息准则（KLIC）最小化问题（相对于某个泊松总体定义）。这一发现为一般误设下的logit伪真实参数提供了简单的刻画（类似于一般条件期望函数（CEF）的（均方误差（MSE）最小化）线性预测近似）。关于抽样理论，稀疏性意味着logit伪复合对数似然得分的扩展Hoeffding型方差分解中的第一项和最后一项具有相同的阶数。相比之下，在密集网络渐近性下，最后一项是渐近可忽略的。使用三角阵列的鞅中心极限定理（CLT）证明了逻辑回归系数的渐近正态性。与密集情况不同，这里推导的正态性结果在网络图on退化的情况下也成立。相关地，当手头数据集中“恰好”没有二元依赖性时，它专门适用于最近推导的关于稀有事件和独立同分布数据的逻辑回归行为的结果。模拟结果表明，稀疏网络渐近性更好地近似了logit估计量的有限网络分布。一个简短的实证说明和额外的校准蒙特卡洛实验进一步说明了主要的理论思想。

articles.title_en: Matching and Agglomeration: Theory and Evidence From Japanese Firm‐to‐Firm Trade
articles.title_cn: 匹配与集聚：来自日本企业间贸易的理论与证据
articles.abstract_en: This paper shows that matching frictions and a thick market externality in firm‐to‐firm trade shape the agglomeration of economic activity. Using panel data of firm‐to‐firm trade in Japan, I demonstrate that firms gradually match with alternative suppliers following an unanticipated supplier bankruptcy, and that the rate of rematching increases in the geographic density of alternative suppliers. Motivated by these empirical findings, I develop a general equilibrium model of firm‐to‐firm matching in input trade across space. The model reveals that the thick market externality gives rise to an agglomeration externality affecting regional production and welfare. Using the calibrated model to the reduced‐form patterns of firm‐to‐firm matching, I estimate that the elasticity of a region's real wage with respect to population density due to the thick market externality is approximately 0.02. This finding highlights the substantial impact of the thick market externality on the overall agglomeration benefit.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文表明，企业间贸易中的匹配摩擦和厚市场外部性塑造了经济活动的集聚。利用日本企业间贸易的面板数据，我证明了企业在遭遇未预期的供应商破产后，会逐渐与替代供应商匹配，并且重新匹配率随替代供应商的地理密度增加而提高。受这些实证发现的启发，我建立了一个跨空间投入贸易中企业间匹配的一般均衡模型。模型揭示，厚市场外部性产生了一种影响区域生产和福利的集聚外部性。利用校准模型拟合企业间匹配的简化形式模式，我估计由于厚市场外部性，区域实际工资对人口密度的弹性约为0.02。这一发现凸显了厚市场外部性对整体集聚效益的重大影响。

articles.abstract_en: A signal is privacy‐preserving with respect to a collection of privacy sets if the posterior probability assigned to every privacy set remains unchanged conditional on any signal realization. We characterize the privacy‐preserving signals for arbitrary state space and arbitrary privacy sets. A signal is privacy‐preserving if and only if it is a garbling of a reordered quantile signal. Furthermore, distributions of posterior means induced by privacy‐preserving signals are exactly mean‐preserving contractions of that induced by the quantile signal. We discuss the economic implications of our characterization for statistical discrimination, the revelation of sensitive information in auctions and price discrimination.
articles.abstract_cn: 如果对于任意信号实现，每个隐私集的后验概率保持不变，则该信号相对于一组隐私集是隐私保护的。我们刻画了任意状态空间和任意隐私集下的隐私保护信号。一个信号是隐私保护的当且仅当它是重排序分位数信号的扰动。此外，由隐私保护信号诱导的后验均值分布恰好是分位数信号诱导的后验均值分布的均值保持收缩。我们讨论了我们的刻画对统计歧视、拍卖中敏感信息揭示和价格歧视的经济学含义。

articles.title_en: Stationary Social Learning in a Changing Environment
articles.title_cn: 变化环境中的平稳社会学习
articles.abstract_en: We consider social learning in a changing world. With changing states, societies can be responsive only if agents regularly act upon fresh information, which significantly limits the value of observational learning. When the state is close to persistent, a consensus whereby most agents choose the same action typically emerges. However, the consensus action is not perfectly correlated with the state, because societies exhibit inertia following state changes. When signals are precise enough, learning is incomplete, even if agents draw large samples of past actions, as actions then become too correlated within samples, thereby reducing informativeness and welfare.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们考虑变化世界中的社会学习。随着状态的变化，只有当个体定期依据新信息行动时，社会才能做出响应，这显著限制了观察学习的价值。当状态接近持久时，通常会出现一种共识，即大多数个体选择相同的行动。然而，共识行动与状态并非完全相关，因为社会在状态变化后表现出惯性。当信号足够精确时，即使个体抽取大量过去行动样本，学习也是不完整的，因为样本内的行动变得过于相关，从而降低了信息量和福利。

articles.abstract_en: We explore the deliberate infusion of ambiguity into the design of contracts. We show that when the agent is ambiguity‐averse and hence chooses an action that maximizes their minimum utility, the principal can strictly gain from using an ambiguous contract, and this gain can be arbitrarily high. We characterize the structure of optimal ambiguous contracts, showing that ambiguity drives optimal contracts toward simplicity. We also provide a characterization of ambiguity‐proof classes of contracts, where the principal cannot gain by infusing ambiguity. Finally, we show that when the agent can engage in mixed actions, the advantages of ambiguous contracts disappear.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们探讨了在契约设计中刻意引入模糊性的问题。我们证明，当代理人具有模糊厌恶特征，因而选择能够最大化其最低效用的行动时，委托人可以通过使用模糊契约获得严格收益，且这种收益可以任意高。我们刻画了最优模糊契约的结构，表明模糊性促使最优契约趋于简单化。我们还提供了模糊免疫契约类别的特征描述，在这些类别中，委托人无法通过引入模糊性获得收益。最后，我们证明当代理人可以采取混合行动时，模糊契约的优势会消失。

articles.title_en: Social Media and Collective Action in China
articles.title_cn: 社交媒体与中国集体行动
articles.abstract_en: This paper studies how social media affects the dynamics of protests and strikes in China during 2009–2017. Based on 13.2 billion microblog posts, we use tweets and retweets to measure social media communication across cities and exploit its rapid expansion for identification. We find that, despite strict government censorship, Chinese social media has a sizeable effect on the geographical spread of protests and strikes. Furthermore, social media communication considerably expands the scope of protests by spreading events across different causes (e.g., from anticorruption protests to environmental protests) and dramatically increases the probability of far‐reaching protest waves with simultaneous events occurring in many cities. These effects arise even though Chinese social media barely circulates content that explicitly helps organize protests.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了社交媒体如何影响2009-2017年间中国抗议和罢工的动态。基于13.2亿条微博帖子，我们利用推文和转发来衡量城市间的社交媒体交流，并利用其快速扩张进行识别。我们发现，尽管政府严格审查，中国社交媒体对抗议和罢工的地理传播具有显著影响。此外，社交媒体交流通过将事件传播到不同原因（例如，从反腐败抗议到环境抗议）大大扩展了抗议的范围，并显著增加了在许多城市同时发生事件的深远抗议浪潮的可能性。即使中国社交媒体几乎不传播明确帮助组织抗议的内容，这些效应也会出现。

articles.title_en: Adaptive, Rate‐Optimal Hypothesis Testing in Nonparametric IV Models
articles.title_cn: 非参数工具变量模型中的自适应、速率最优假设检验
articles.abstract_en: We propose a new adaptive hypothesis test for inequality (e.g., monotonicity, convexity) and equality (e.g., parametric, semiparametric) restrictions on a structural function in a nonparametric instrumental variables (NPIV) model. Our test statistic is based on a modified leave‐one‐out sample analog of a quadratic distance between the restricted and unrestricted sieve two‐stage least squares estimators. We provide computationally simple, data‐driven choices of sieve tuning parameters and Bonferroni adjusted chi‐squared critical values. Our test adapts to the unknown smoothness of alternative functions in the presence of unknown degree of endogeneity and unknown strength of the instruments. It attains the adaptive minimax rate of testing in L2. That is, the sum of the supremum of type I error over the composite null and the supremum of type II error over nonparametric alternative models cannot be minimized by any other tests for NPIV models of unknown regularities. Confidence sets in L2 are obtained by inverting the adaptive test. Simulations confirm that, across different strength of instruments and sample sizes, our adaptive test controls size and its finite‐sample power greatly exceeds existing non‐adaptive tests for monotonicity and parametric restrictions in NPIV models. Empirical applications to test for shape restrictions of differentiated products demand and of Engel curves are presented.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一种新的自适应假设检验，用于非参数工具变量（NPIV）模型中结构函数的不等式（如单调性、凸性）和等式（如参数、半参数）约束。我们的检验统计量基于受限与非受限筛子两阶段最小二乘估计量之间二次距离的修正留一法样本模拟。我们提供了计算简单、数据驱动的筛子调参参数选择和邦费罗尼调整的卡方临界值。我们的检验适应于未知内生性程度和未知工具强度下备择函数的未知光滑性。它在L2中达到了自适应的极小极大检验速率。也就是说，在复合原假设下第一类错误的上确界与非参数备择模型下第二类错误的上确界之和，不能被任何其他针对未知正则性的NPIV模型的检验所最小化。通过反转自适应检验获得L2中的置信集。模拟证实，在不同的工具强度和样本量下，我们的自适应检验控制了规模，其有限样本功效大大超过了现有的针对NPIV模型中单调性和参数约束的非自适应检验。我们还提供了对差异化产品需求和恩格尔曲线形状约束检验的实证应用。

articles.abstract_en: We introduce Cautious Utility, a new model based on the idea that individuals are unsure of trade‐offs between goods and apply caution. The model yields an endowment effect, even when gains and losses are treated symmetrically. Moreover, it implies either loss aversion or loss neutrality for risk, but in a way unrelated to the endowment effect, and it captures the certainty effect, providing a novel unified explanation of all three phenomena. Cautious Utility can help organize empirical evidence, including some that directly contradicts leading alternatives.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们引入了谨慎效用，这是一个基于个体对商品间权衡不确定并采取谨慎态度这一思想的新模型。该模型产生了禀赋效应，即使收益和损失被对称对待时也是如此。此外，它意味着风险方面的损失厌恶或损失中性，但这种方式与禀赋效应无关，并且它捕捉了确定性效应，为所有这三种现象提供了一种新颖的统一解释。谨慎效用有助于组织经验证据，包括一些直接与主要替代理论相矛盾的证据。
